title: did:key encode/decode and 'git vouch did'
description: SSH pubkey <-> did:key: multibase base58btc of multicodec prefix + raw key. ed25519 and sk-ed25519 -> 0xed; ecdsa-nistp256 and sk-ecdsa -> 0x1200 compressed point. Reject RSA/DSA. Implement base58 and P-256 point compression in stdlib. 'git vouch did' prints either direction.
acceptance_criteria: Tests use W3C CCG did:key test vectors (hardcoded, offline) as oracle, never git-vouch output; ed25519 and P-256 both covered; RSA/DSA rejected with non-zero exit.
